diff_causality.evidence: This patch addition creates the JavaScript execution pathway that passes user data to the calibre_extract.show_footnote function

security_control.evidence: JSON encoding is properly applied via json.dumps, but JavaScript context encoding may be needed
security_control.required_control: Proper JavaScript context encoding for user data passed to JavaScript execution

existing_controls_checked: JSON encoding via json.dumps for data serialization
security_control.deficiency_evidence: JSON encoding is proper but may be insufficient for JavaScript context if calibre_extract.show_footnote improperly handles the data

concrete_impact.evidence: Impact depends on how calibre_extract.show_footnote handles the user data - no demonstrated security consequence

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the JavaScript execution that passes user-controlled data to calibre_extract.show_footnote would not occur, eliminating this data flow path.
